description: Data + edge layer for recent orders: add the single-partition byCreatedAt GSI to OrdersTable, create the new least-privilege read-only orders_list boto3 Lambda behind GET /api/orders, wire it in the AppEdgeAI stack with its OWN role (grantReadData + kmsKey.grantDecrypt; assistant grants UNCHANGED), correct+extend the deploy.sh seed items, and add strands-free/boto3-free unit tests for list_recent_orders and the mirrored derive_status. Depends on FEAT-001 for the persisted item shape (gsiPk/createdAt/summary/total) and the derive_status thresholds it mirrors. See design.md sections 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12.
steps: In infra/lib/security-data-stack.ts, immediately after the OrdersTable is created, call ordersTable.addGlobalSecondaryIndex({ indexName: 'byCreatedAt', partitionKey: { name: 'gsiPk', type: dynamodb.AttributeType.STRING }, sortKey: { name: 'createdAt', type: dynamodb.AttributeType.NUMBER }, projectionType: dynamodb.ProjectionType.ALL }) with the design.md section 2 comment (single constant 'ORDER' partition = one hot partition, an accepted demo simplification so recent orders is a Query not a Scan; do not generalise the PK). Do not change encryption/billing/keys/removalPolicy.
Create app/orders_list/__init__.py as an EMPTY file (mirrors app/presign/__init__.py and app/refund_confirm/__init__.py) so the test harness can import orders_list.handler as a package.

Create app/orders_list/handler.py mirroring app/presign/handler.py structure: guarded `import boto3`; guarded `from aws_xray_sdk.core import patch_all; patch_all()`; `import json, os, time`; a _response(status, body) helper identical to presign's. Add a MIRRORED derive_status with PREPARING_AFTER=20/READY_AFTER=60 IDENTICAL to the FEAT-001 copy in tools.py (same constants, same half-open logic, same comment) — the zip Lambda cannot import the assistant package.

In app/orders_list/handler.py add pure list_recent_orders(table, gsi_name, now, limit=10) -> dict (design.md section 5): resp = table.query(IndexName=gsi_name, KeyConditionExpression=Key('gsiPk').eq('ORDER'), ScanIndexForward=False, Limit=limit) — but keep it boto3-free-importable by building the KeyConditionExpression without importing boto3 at module top (either guard the boto3.dynamodb.conditions import or accept the stub recording raw kwargs; follow presign's guarded-import style). For each item skip any missing orderId/createdAt, coerce total to float, compute status=derive_status(int(createdAt), now); return {'orders': [ {orderId, summary, total(float), status, createdAt(int)} ... ]} newest-first (the query already returns newest-first). Empty Items -> {'orders': []}. Never call scan.

In app/orders_list/handler.py add handler(event, _context): ddb = boto3.resource('dynamodb'); table = ddb.Table(os.environ['ORDERS_TABLE']); try: body = list_recent_orders(table, os.environ['ORDERS_GSI_NAME'], int(time.time())) except Exception: return _response(500, {'error': 'could not list orders'}); return _response(200, body). Read NO request input (parameterless endpoint).

In infra/lib/app-edge-ai-stack.ts add const ordersListFn = new lambda.Function(this, 'OrdersListFn', { runtime: PYTHON_3_12, handler: 'handler.handler', code: lambda.Code.fromAsset(path.join(appRoot, 'orders_list')), timeout: cdk.Duration.seconds(30), memorySize: 256, tracing: lambda.Tracing.ACTIVE, environment: { AWS_REGION_PINNED: REGION, ORDERS_TABLE: ordersTable.tableName, ORDERS_GSI_NAME: 'byCreatedAt' } }).

In infra/lib/app-edge-ai-stack.ts grant least-privilege read-only on the NEW function's OWN role only: const ordersListRole = ordersListFn.role as iam.Role; ordersTable.grantReadData(ordersListRole); kmsKey.grantDecrypt(ordersListRole). Do NOT reuse the assistant role, do NOT add any write action, do NOT modify the assistant role or env. Keep the design.md section 10 comment explaining grantReadData covers Query on table + index and stays read-only.

In infra/lib/app-edge-ai-stack.ts add the route under the existing apiRoot (api.root.addResource('api')): const orders = apiRoot.addResource('orders'); orders.addMethod('GET', new apigateway.LambdaIntegration(ordersListFn)). Leave CloudFront (/api/* CACHING_DISABLED), WAF, and the Bedrock endpoints UNCHANGED.

In deploy.sh, before the seed put-item lines, add NOW=$(date +%s). Change the two put-item --item payloads to the corrected/extended shape (design.md section 11.4): ORD-000123 => {"orderId":{"S":"ORD-000123"},"summary":{"S":"1x Flat White, 1x Croissant"},"total":{"N":"7.50"},"status":{"S":"RECEIVED"},"gsiPk":{"S":"ORDER"},"createdAt":{"N":"$((NOW-90))"}}; ORD-000456 => {"orderId":{"S":"ORD-000456"},"summary":{"S":"2x Latte"},"total":{"N":"9.50"},"status":{"S":"RECEIVED"},"gsiPk":{"S":"ORDER"},"createdAt":{"N":"$((NOW-30))"}}. Leave the rest of deploy.sh unchanged.

Create app/tests/test_orders_list.py (strands-free, boto3-free): a _StubTable whose query(**kwargs) records kwargs and returns a canned {'Items': [...]}, plus a variant that raises. Assert list_recent_orders queries IndexName=='byCreatedAt', the gsiPk condition equals 'ORDER', ScanIndexForward is False, Limit==10, scan is never called, the response is {'orders': [...]} with total a float and status derived, items missing orderId/createdAt are skipped, and empty Items -> {'orders': []}. Assert the handler wrapper maps a raised query to _response(500, {'error':'could not list orders'}). If list_recent_orders builds a boto3 KeyConditionExpression object, make the stub tolerant (record the raw kwargs) so the test needs no boto3.

In app/tests (e.g. append to test_orders_list.py or test_tools.py) add a cross-check asserting the two derive_status copies agree: import derive_status + thresholds from assistant.tools and from orders_list.handler and assert equal constants and equal outputs across a sweep of ages (e.g. 0,19,20,59,60,120).

Optional but preferred: in infra/test/template.test.ts add assertions that the Orders table has a GlobalSecondaryIndex named byCreatedAt and that an API Gateway resource 'orders' with a GET method exists. If added, keep them green and do not disturb existing checks.
acceptance_criteria: cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit is clean.
npx cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData shows a GlobalSecondaryIndexes entry IndexName byCreatedAt (gsiPk HASH / createdAt RANGE, projection ALL) on the Orders table.

npx cdk synth SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI shows a new PYTHON_3_12 Lambda for orders_list and an AWS::ApiGateway::Resource PathPart 'orders' with a GET method integrated to it; the assistant Lambda's role and environment are unchanged.
python3 -m pytest app/tests -q is all green including test_orders_list.py; list_recent_orders never calls scan and queries the GSI newest-first with Limit 10.
cd infra && npm test introduces no NEW failures (the single pre-existing ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration failure may remain; see context.json).
deploy.sh passes bash -n and both seed put-item payloads carry gsiPk/createdAt/status with corrected totals 7.50 and 9.50.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved: orders_list role is a NEW dedicated role with read-only grantReadData + kmsKey.grantDecrypt only; assistant grants/env unchanged; no Scan; region ap-southeast-1 unchanged; no weakening of WAF/KMS/PrivateLink/TLS/Guardrail.
verification: From demo root: python3 -m py_compile $(find app -name '*.py')
From demo root: python3 -m pytest app/tests -q  (expect all green)
cd infra && npx cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData | grep -A6 byCreatedAt  (confirm the GSI)
cd infra && npx cdk synth SecureAssistantAppEdgeAI  (confirm OrdersListFn + GET /api/orders; assistant role unchanged)
cd infra && npm test  (treat as passing if the only failure is the pre-existing ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration assertion)
findings:
Implemented: byCreatedAt GSI on OrdersTable (security-data-stack.ts, added immediately after table creation, before this.ordersTable assignment); new read-only app/orders_list/ Lambda (empty __init__.py + handler.py mirroring app/presign) wired as GET /api/orders in app-edge-ai-stack.ts with its OWN role (grantReadData + kmsKey.grantDecrypt); corrected+extended deploy.sh seed; app/tests/test_orders_list.py (8 new tests incl. derive_status cross-check).

VERIFICATION: python3 -m py_compile clean; python3 -m pytest app/tests -q = 39 passed (31 FEAT-001 baseline + 8 new). (cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit) clean. cdk synth SecurityData shows GlobalSecondaryIndexes IndexName byCreatedAt (gsiPk HASH / createdAt RANGE, Projection ALL). cdk synth AppEdgeAI shows OrdersListFn (Runtime python3.12, Handler handler.handler, env ORDERS_TABLE + ORDERS_GSI_NAME=byCreatedAt) and AWS::ApiGateway::Resource PathPart 'orders' with a GET method integrated to it. (cd infra && npm test): only the pre-existing ModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration assertion fails (expected, out of scope); added two NEW green assertions (byCreatedAt GSI; orders resource + GET method). bash -n deploy.sh OK.

CONTRACTS FOR FEAT-003/004:

GET /api/orders response contract (200): {"orders": [ {orderId:str, summary:str, total:float, status:str, createdAt:int(epoch sec)}, ... ]} up to 10 items, NEWEST-FIRST (byCreatedAt query ScanIndexForward=False, Limit=10). status is the DERIVED live status (derive_status(createdAt, now)) NOT the stored baseline 'RECEIVED'. Empty table -> {"orders": []} with 200. On any DynamoDB query failure -> 500 {"error": "could not list orders"} (generic, no leak); the SPA should keep its last-rendered list and retry next poll. Parameterless endpoint — no path/query/body input is read. Items missing orderId/createdAt are skipped. Response envelope is the standard {statusCode, headers:{Content-Type: application/json}, body: json.dumps(...)} (API Gateway Lambda proxy).

Orders table id (discovered via cdk synth): CDK logical id 'OrdersTable' renders to AWS::DynamoDB::Table logical id 'OrdersTable315BB997'. deploy.sh resolves the PHYSICAL table name at runtime via describe-stack-resources filtering ResourceType==AWS::DynamoDB::Table && contains(LogicalResourceId,'Orders') — unchanged and still correct. GSI name is the constant 'byCreatedAt' (passed to the Lambda via ORDERS_GSI_NAME env, not hardcoded in Python).

derive_status mirrored IDENTICALLY in app/orders_list/handler.py (PREPARING_AFTER=20, READY_AFTER=60, half-open: elapsed<20 RECEIVED, elapsed<60 PREPARING, else READY). A pytest cross-check asserts the orders_list copy and the assistant.tools copy agree on constants and on outputs for ages 0,19,20,59,60,120.

HARD INVARIANTS preserved: orders_list role is a NEW dedicated role (ordersListFn.role) with read-only grantReadData + kmsKey.grantDecrypt ONLY (synth shows dynamodb read actions incl. the grantReadData-provided Scan permission, but the Lambda code NEVER calls scan — recent orders is a Query on the GSI; NO write actions PutItem/UpdateItem/DeleteItem/BatchWriteItem present); the assistant role + env are UNCHANGED (synth confirms assistant still has PutItem/UpdateItem/DeleteItem and all original env vars); region ap-southeast-1 unchanged; WAF/KMS/PrivateLink/TLS/Guardrail/CloudFront behaviors untouched (GET /api/orders is covered by the existing /api/* CACHING_DISABLED behavior, no distribution change needed). Lambda stays importable without boto3 (guarded boto3 + boto3.dynamodb.conditions.Key imports; pure list_recent_orders is unit-tested with a stub).
